findings.F1: The test traded a different situation from the idea's: the forecast is the 30-day return standardised against its own past 60 values, so it is below 0 whenever the month is weaker than usual, and 48 of the 159 cases in folds B and C (30 %) had a 30-day return at or above zero; on those cases the short-side unusual 7-day move is −2.73 % (22 days, t −0.77, weighted −5.64 %), against the idea.
findings.F2: On the cases the idea describes, a 30-day return below zero, the short-side unusual 7-day move is +5.14 % (111 cases on 54 days, t 2.67 with one day's cases taken together, weighted +6.96 %), compared with +2.76 % and t 1.57 on 76 days for all the test's cases; the non-falls pull the test's main measure under the bar.
findings.F3: Among the true falls the move is graded by depth as the idea predicts: shallow third +1.14 % (t_day 0.61), middle third +4.04 % (t_day 1.78), deepest third +10.23 % (t_day 2.84), Spearman 0.36 between depth and the move (p 0.0001, 111 cases); the plan's own supporting check also passed (+2.42 %).
findings.F4: The effect is stronger when the coin is agitated: among the true falls, with the 30-day swing above the coin's median, the unusual move is +8.73 % (40 cases, 25 days, t_day 2.65), and when calm it is +3.11 % (71 cases, 36 days, t_day 1.67); per unit of the coin's 7-day swing the strength is 0.53 against 0.19.
findings.F5: The effect belongs to the 7-day horizon and does not last: the mean short-side unusual move over all cases is +1.65 % at 3 days (t 2.19) and +2.76 % at 7 days (t 2.63), then falls to +1.75 % at 14 days (t 0.90) and +1.39 % at 21 days (t 0.52).
findings.F6: The effect varies across periods: most windows are positive, for example w9 at +6.8 % (t 3.16) and w16 at +24.4 % (t 4.59), but w11 is −12.4 % (t −2.27) and w10 is −1.4 %; by year it is positive in each of 2018 to 2021, from +1.3 % to +5.2 %.

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the larger a coin's plain 30-day fall below zero (its close under its close of 30 days earlier), the more it falls over the next 7 days.
ideas.consequence: After a month that ended lower in a trendless market, a trader can short for about a week, sizing the short by how far the price sits below its level of a month ago, and should not short a month that was only weaker than usual.
ideas.name: choppy plain month fall continues

ideas.idea: In a choppy, agitated market, the larger a coin's plain 30-day fall below zero (its close under its close of 30 days earlier), the more it falls over the next 7 days.
ideas.consequence: In a trendless market that is swinging more than usual, a deep month-long fall is a stronger reason to short for the following week.
ideas.name: agitated choppy month fall continues
